title: 第10章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇欧慕瑄推开电脑，拿起办公桌上的电话拨通一个号码，“顾佳泞的绯闻是散播的？！”冰冷的声音夹带着几分怒气。“……不……不知道，”电话那头，欧皇公司的负责人有些胆战心惊，他们的欧总刚交代过要签下这个艺人，结果隔天就出现了这样的绯闻，“不过请总裁放心，我们一定会在最短的时间内去解决！”“明天，我要看到结果！”“……是！”顾佳泞会怎样他毫不在意，跟他也没有半毛钱的关系，他气的是这个该死的女人居然将什么事都算到他的头上，难道他就这么不值得信任吗？然而更可气的是，谁误会他，他向来不会去在意，现在为什么要为了一个叶芊沫而焦躁不已？见鬼！拿起手机，看到手机上有一个陌生号码发来的另外一个陌生号，欧慕瑄将两个号分别存起来，然后利落地拨通叶芊沫的手机。“喂，你是谁啊！”此刻，叶芊沫心里正不爽着。“欧慕瑄……”“欧慕瑄，你这个卑鄙无耻下流的人渣，你特么……”“闭嘴！”欧慕瑄吼断她的话，“晴空广场见，十分钟见不到你的人，我会让顾佳泞从这个世界上永远消失！”欧慕瑄挂断了电话，拿起外套走了出去，卑鄙无耻下流的人渣？女人，你死定了！看来这件事真的不是爹地做的，嗯，他就知道他的爹地不是那种人，小奶娃支着下巴，回味着他与欧慕瑄的聊天记录，看看自己有没有什么表现不好的地方。爹地，能帮你的，儿子都帮了哦，接下来就该看你的了。晴空广场是吧？好，正好她叶芊沫也想好好的跟他算算账，卑鄙的人渣，手段果然都是一些不入流的下三滥，白长了一张绝世的脸，浪费！叶芊沫气冲冲的赶往晴空广场，然而……人呢？尼玛啊，她这是被人耍了么？说好了十分钟见，现在已经十五分钟过去了好不好？气愤之余，叶芊沫突然想到了另外一件事，那啥，晴空广场这么大，他们似乎没有约具体在哪里见吧？智商……她那珠穆朗玛峰一般的高的智商，就这么再次降到索马里海沟去了么？每次遇到欧慕瑄，总是有不顺心的事情发生，叶芊沫一个人傻傻的站在路边等候着绿灯，泥煤，还能有更衰的事情发生么？一旁的咖啡店里，一个修长的身影就这么优雅的坐在靠窗的座位上，琥珀色的眸子饶有趣味地看着不远处那个略微颓废的美丽身影，微薄的唇角斜起一抹嘲弄的笑意。让她等着好了，至于欧慕瑄……唔，先喝杯咖啡，欣赏够了她的狼狈再说。绿灯亮了，叶芊沫刚打算迈开步子走过十字路口，而这时，身上的手机却响了起来，陌生号，难道是欧慕瑄这厮打来的？“人渣，你……”“沫沫？”很温和的男人声音，带着一丝的犹豫，一丝的紧张，一丝的欣喜，就这么轻轻的从电话那头传了过来。这个声音是……叶芊沫顿时愣在了原地，任十字路口人来人往，而她的大脑，猛然一片空白，忘记了该怎么去思考，忘记了该怎么去反应，往事想要从脑海中被压抑的角落里翻涌而出，然而此时，却失去了任何回忆的力量。那个声音，是属于司徒洛天的，那是曾经在无数个夜晚，夜夜在噩梦里折磨她的人，那是她这六年来，一直想要拼命的去忘记，去忽略的一个人……而现在，这个人的声音，就这么，突然的，再次出现！那天，她哭着求他不要娶别人，而他，只是跟她说了一句对不起……那天，她第一次放低自己的高傲，自己的自尊，将身上的衣服一件件的脱落，而他，只捡起来，重新披到她的身上……那天，她发誓要将他逐出她的世界！刚去到法国，她自以为流利的法语竟然与当地人无法交流，要别人重复很多遍，才可以勉强听懂别人在说什么，那时候，她孤独一人在异国的街头，脑海里浮现的，全部都是司徒洛天的电话号码。她想要打电话给他，想要告诉她，此刻她有多么的想念他，然而，她忍住了，她的自尊，已经在他的面前丢过一次了，够了！六年前，她因为出身不好，家世不好，甚至不如那个女人漂亮，而在六年后的现在，她是星空啊，享誉全球的顶尖服装设计师，那么，她还害怕什么？她应该高傲的站在他面前，让他后悔当初放弃了她，不是吗？“沫沫？”听不到对方的回应，电话那头，司徒洛天不确定地轻喊着她的名字，“沫沫，我是……”“我知道你是谁，你是……”他的名字，就这么卡在了她的嗓子里！说不出来，他的名字，不管是在六年前还是六年后，她依然无法轻松的叫出口，无法像一个陌生人那样，若无其事的叫出来。心，痛得像是有无数把利剑穿过，叶芊沫死死咬住下唇，将身体里多余的**狠狠的逼回去，拒绝从眼睛里掉下来！不许哭，叶芊沫，一个已经背叛你的人，不值得你为他掉一滴眼泪！红灯亮了，然而叶芊沫却依旧站在原地，苍白的脸上带着倔强的笑容，死死压抑着内心的难过，固执的维持着自己的高傲和自尊。“你……找我有事吗？”叶芊沫尽量保持着声音的平静。“沫沫，你回来了对不对？我想见你！”司徒洛天急切的说着，像是在对自己许久不见的恋爱表达爱意那般。想见她？叶芊沫冷笑，现在想见了，那么以前你干嘛去了，六年前，你不是你知道她在哪个学校读书？可是你有去找过她么？呵，现在才说想念，真是可笑之极！咖啡厅，看着在明亮的阳光下，却明明瑟瑟发抖的单薄身子，欧慕瑄紧紧握住手中的咖啡杯，尤其是当他看到一辆辆车从她身边快速的驶过，而她无知无觉，甚至随时都有可能来一辆车撞到她……心，像是被一直无形的手攫住，继而，是一阵无名的怒火！这个女人，站在马路中央打电话，不要命了么！他已经忍了很久，可是那个可恶的死丫头依然动也不动的站在马路中央，她是石化了么？灵魂被风吹走了么？！于是，忍无可忍的欧慕瑄猛然站起身，大步走出咖啡厅。
content_en: Chapter 1 Encounter at the Bar Ou Muxuan pushed away the computer, picked up the phone on his desk and dialed a number, "Did Gu Jia Ning's scandal spread?!" The cold voice was filled with anger. "...No...I don't know." On the other end of the phone, the person in charge of Ouhuang Company was a little frightened. Their President Ou had just promised to sign this artist, but such a scandal appeared the next day, "But please don't worry, CEO, we will definitely go there as soon as possible." Solve it!" "Tomorrow, I want to see the result!" "...Yes!" He doesn't care what happens to Gu Jiani, and it has nothing to do with him. He is angry that this damn woman blames him for everything. Is he so untrustworthy? But what's even more irritating is that he never cares about anyone who misunderstands him. Why is he so anxious about Ye Qianmo now? Damn it! Picking up the phone, Ou Muchuan saw that there was another unfamiliar number on the phone from an unknown number. He saved the two numbers separately, and then dialed Ye Qianmo's mobile phone neatly. "Hey, who are you!" At this moment, Ye Qianmo was feeling unhappy. "Ou Muxuan..." "Ou Muxuan, you despicable, shameless and despicable scum, what the hell are you..." "Shut up!" Ou Muxuan shouted at her, "See you at Qingkong Square, if I don't see you for ten minutes, I will make Gu Jiali disappear from this world forever!" Ou Muxuan hung up the phone, picked up his coat and walked out, despicable, shameless and despicable scum? Woman, you are dead! It seems that his father really didn't do this. Well, he knew that his father was not that kind of person. The little baby propped his chin and reviewed the chat history between him and Ou Muchuan to see if there was anything wrong with his performance. Daddy, my son has done everything he can to help you. Now it’s up to you. Sky Plaza, right? Well, it just so happened that she, Ye Qianmo, also wanted to settle the score with him. The despicable scum's methods were indeed despicable. He had a peerless face in vain. What a waste! Ye Qianmo rushed to Qingkong Square angrily, but... where were the people? Damn it, was she being tricked? We agreed to meet in ten minutes, but now fifteen minutes have passed, okay? While being angry, Ye Qianmo suddenly thought of another thing, what, Qingkong Square is so big, they didn't seem to have an appointment on where to meet, right? IQ... Did her IQ, as high as Mount Everest, just drop to the Somali Trench again? Every time I met Ou Muxuan, something bad always happened. Ye Qianmo stood alone on the roadside waiting for the green light. Peat, could anything worse happen? In a nearby coffee shop, a slender figure sat elegantly on a window seat. His amber eyes looked at the slightly decadent and beautiful figure not far away with interest, and the corners of his thin lips curved into a mocking smile. Just let her wait. As for Ou Muchuan... well, let's have a cup of coffee first and appreciate her embarrassment before we talk. The light turned green, and Ye Qianmo was about to walk across the intersection, but at this moment, the cell phone on her body rang. Could it be an unknown number? Could it be Ou Muxuan? "Scum, you..." "Momo?" A very gentle man's voice, with a trace of hesitation, a trace of nervousness, and a trace of joy, came so gently from the other end of the phone. The voice was... Ye Qianmo suddenly froze on the spot, letting people come and go at the intersection, and her brain suddenly went blank. She forgot how to think and how to react. The past wanted to surge out from the repressed corners of her mind, but at this time, she lost the power of any memories. That voice belonged to Situ Luotian. It was the person who had tortured her in nightmares on countless nights. It was the person she had been trying desperately to forget and ignore in the past six years... But now, this person's voice suddenly appeared again! That day, she cried and begged him not to marry someone else, but he just said sorry to her... That day, for the first time, she lowered her arrogance and self-esteem and took off her clothes one by one, but he just picked them up and put them on her body again... That day, she vowed to drive him out of her world! When she first arrived in France, she thought she was fluent in French but could not communicate with the locals. She had to be repeated many times before she could barely understand what others were saying. At that time, she was alone on the streets of a foreign country, and all that came to her mind was Situ Luotian's phone number. She wanted to call him and tell her how much she missed him at this moment, but she held back. Her self-esteem had been lost in front of him once, that was enough! Six years ago, she was not even as beautiful as that woman because of her poor background and family background. But now, six years later, she is Xingkong, a world-renowned top fashion designer. So, what else is she afraid of? She should stand proudly in front of him and make him regret giving up on her, right? "Momo?" She couldn't hear the other party's response. On the other end of the phone, Situ Luotian whispered her name uncertainly, "Momo, I am..." "I know who you are, you are..." His name was stuck in her throat! She couldn't say his name, whether it was six years ago or six years later, she still couldn't say it easily, she couldn't say it out like a stranger, as if nothing had happened. Her heart hurt as if countless sharp swords had penetrated it. Ye Qianmo bit her lower lip and pushed back the excess fat in her body, refusing to fall out of her eyes! Don't cry, Ye Qianmo, a person who has betrayed you is not worth a tear for you! The red light turned on, but Ye Qianmo still stood there with a stubborn smile on her pale face, suppressing her inner sadness and stubbornness.
